direct_push_to_main_risk.risk: Direct pushes to main bypass normal PR review evidence and can trigger production/release workflows before the enterprise approval record is complete.
direct_push_to_main_risk.required_response: Treat any direct push to main as a release governance exception. Do not promote the commit until branch protection evidence is Complete and Full Security Suite / Enterprise merge/deploy gate is green for the exact commit.
